actual_scope: One native tensor Clifford child under arbitrary invertible reciprocal linear encoding: same-direction lanes with fully restored dirty padding; opposite-direction two-lane sharpness.
scope_change_reason: The assigned synthesis card first requires a legal higher-rank child. PR1779/1817 leave this contract open; Ross Richardson has already excluded monomial wrappers. Change that hypothesis to arbitrary linear similarity, rather than repeat the support-count audit or batch-count search. This is a scoped obstruction and an exact mixed-direction identity, not satisfaction of the 5% physical-construction gate.
bottleneck_link: Larger child ranks are useful only with a correct full-space operator and volume charge. Trace invariants decide whether a free reciprocal basis can replace independent equal-rank children by one higher-rank tensor child; the opposite-direction exception identifies the direction premise that changes.
stop_rule: Prove the all-size statement; replay complete Gaussian matrices through total address dimension 5, independent integer multiplicities through f=64, plus semantic controls and source/receipt rejection. Stop without physical synthesis if even the zero-adapter inherited volume bill cannot improve.
evidence: Written all-size characteristic-zero reciprocal-basis classification, complete opposite-direction classification by f mod 4, correction rank floor >=6, 28032 spectral fixtures through f=64, 2728 exact native matrix entries, three full rational basis witnesses and six semantic scope controls. Independent Gaussian elimination and six focused mathematical/source/receipt/relocation/regeneration test groups.

method: Trace of the square eliminates restored identity padding. Trace norm and dimension fix rank. Integer fourth-root multiplicities prove and construct the opposite-direction exception. Two independent finite operator/multiplicity engines and full dirty-space fixtures.
optimistic_budget: All encoding, routing, frame, source/copy, hosting, precision and restoration costs waived. Any joined rank h>f call has volume qV, so inherited bill q A V h^sigma exceeds q A V f^sigma for every sigma>0. This compares upper-bound expressions, not optimal runtime lower bounds.
